paragraphs: Yeiva, the father-in-law of Ashyan bar Nadbakh.
Mentioned in Bava Batra 22b: he spoke in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: חמוה explicitly gives father-in-law. Yeiva reports in Rav’s name at the source’s Bava Batra 22b locator; Rav is full, while the heading has no personal title. The named William Davidson vocalized passage likewise identifies Yeiva as Ashyan bar Nadbakh’s father-in-law.
